about_blocks.text: Teen Challenge Canada – Ontario Men’s Centre is a drug and alcohol rehabilitation centre located in London, Ontario. It offers a 12-month in-residence drug and alcohol recovery program for adult men aged 18 and above. The program aims to provide holistic recovery by focusing on spirituality, academics, and vocational training. The centre is part of a network of over 19 Teen Challenge Centres across Canada and more than 1,500 worldwide.

about_blocks.text: Teen Challenge Canada – Ontario Men’s Centre uses a faith-based approach in its drug and alcohol recovery program. The centre believes that faith in God and developing a personal relationship with Him is the key to overcoming addiction. The program offers spiritual training including Bible study, worship, and prayer. The centre also provides academic and vocational training to equip individuals to return to society as responsible citizens.

about_blocks.text: The Teen Challenge Ontario Men’s Centre has a rich history of helping men overcome addiction and achieve lasting freedom. Founded in 1991, the centre is part of a global organization that has been providing life-changing support for over 50 years. Their mission is to help people who are struggling with substance abuse and other life-controlling issues find hope and healing through faith in Jesus Christ.

about_blocks.text: The Ontario Men’s Centre provides a comprehensive residential program that includes counselling, education, and vocational training. They offer a holistic approach to recovery that addresses the physical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of addiction. Their highly skilled staff is dedicated to helping men break the cycle of addiction and rebuild their lives. With a peaceful and secluded location on 46 acres of beautiful countryside, the Ontario Men’s Centre provides a safe and supportive environment for men to begin their recovery journey.
